title: CRM integrations

lessons.title: Salesforce wants Lightning and the console
lessons.summary: Agent Workspace for Salesforce is Lightning only. Console navigation keeps records on one screen. Standard navigation opens a new browser tab per interaction.

p: The Salesforce Agent Workspace page says the integration is only available in Salesforce Lightning. The org should use console navigation, not standard navigation.
With standard navigation, each interaction's record opens in a new browser tab. With console navigation, records open as tabs on the same Salesforce screen.

Create a Salesforce user for CXone configuration. The page recommends administrator privileges. If you refuse that, the user still needs read on all entity records and fields, and read/write on entities the workflows update, including search, create, and data memorialization.
Allow https://nicecxone.integration-authentication.com/oauth2/token on the security network.

lessons.title: Agent Integrations is a per-employee switch
lessons.summary: Enable Customer Card and Agent Integrations on the employee. Billing follows the count of employees with Agent Integrations. The account representative enables Agent Integrations for the system.

p: In Admin > Employees, enable Customer Card so agents can see the card. Enable Agent Integrations so they can use Agent Workspace for Salesforce and see Salesforce records in the card.
You are billed for CRM integration based on the number of employees with Agent Integrations enabled. This page does not list a price. Do not invent one.
Agent Integrations must be enabled for the system. The account representative can help.
Turning the attribute on for every employee 'just in case' is a billing event, not a harmless default.

lessons.title: The script still has to change
lessons.summary: You need Scripts Create/Edit. The process is a CRM configuration, a Studio change, workflows, then optional manual create and optional reskill.
objectives: Leave workflow field lists to the page

p: The page's process is: set up a CRM configuration for Salesforce, modify the Studio script, configure Salesforce workflows or configure them with ENHANCED WORKFLOW EXECUTE, optionally let agents create records, and optionally configure reskill scripting for create workflows.
You need the Scripts Create/Edit permission before the Studio step is real.
Search, create, and data memorialization are named. The field-by-field workflow designer is not reprinted here.
AutoSummary's Contact / Disposition Notes mapping is a further mapping on Agent Integrations, from the AutoSummary setup page, not a step this Salesforce page replaces.

lessons.title: Einstein is a virtual agent, not the CRM screen
lessons.summary: Salesforce Einstein connects through Virtual Agent Hub and TextBot Exchange for digital chat. It is not the same project as Agent Workspace inside Lightning.
objectives: Keep it off the console project

p: The Einstein page connects Salesforce Einstein as a virtual agent through Virtual Agent Hub and TextBot Exchange. The channel is digital chat.
That is the same family as other text virtual agents: the hub and the script, not a SIP backchannel.
Agent Workspace inside Salesforce Lightning is the CRM screen for a human agent. Einstein is a bot on chat.
A project that only finishes the console integration has not deployed Einstein, and the reverse is also true.

lessons.title: Ticketing currently names Salesforce and Zendesk
lessons.summary: CRM Ticketing needs a license and Ticket Search permission. The FAQ says Salesforce and Zendesk are the supported CRMs. Users and name changes belong in the CRM. Tickets import when solved, and 90 days is the retention.
objectives: Keep identity edits in the CRM

p: You need a CRM Ticketing license and the Search & Playback > Search > Ticket Search permission. Tickets are searched in the Interactions application.

The FAQ says currently Salesforce and Zendesk are supported. The introduction also says systems like Salesforce, Zendesk, and others, and mentions One-Connector APIs. This lesson treats the FAQ list as the supported CRMs and marks the word others as unresolved.

Create agents and change name or email in the CRM, not in CXone. First and last name are required. Email addresses are not accepted in those name fields. The email must be unique across active and inactive users. Users without an email are not created, and their tickets are not imported.
Only solved or resolved tickets import. Only the last 90 days are retained, and the FAQ says you cannot set a different retention. A sync failure email goes out at 13:00 local time.

lessons.title: The channel list, including a repeated Slack
lessons.summary: The ticketing page lists email, chat, Facebook, forum, in-app messaging, Slack, SMS, voice, WhatsApp, Telegram, Viber, Apple Messages for Business, Slack again, and Microsoft Teams. Slack appears twice. QM can evaluate a ticket. Default columns are not customizable.

p: The page's channel answer includes Email, Chat, Facebook, Forum, In App Messaging (SMS), Slack, SMS Messaging, Voice Calls, WhatsApp, Telegram, Viber, Apple Messages for Business, Slack again, and Microsoft Teams.
Because Slack is repeated, this lesson does not invent a reason. It marks the duplicate as uncertain.
The FAQ says you can evaluate a ticket and that the integration uses Quality Management. Transcripts and recordings sit on the Ticket Info tab, with a link back to the CRM.

You cannot customize the default fields in Tickets Search and Tickets Viewer. Filters can be customized. A temporary Store and Forward copy of up to 3 months is mentioned on the same page and is not subject to GDPR enforcement.

lessons.title: Salesforce Voice 26.3 needs one IndexedDB delete
lessons.summary: Upgrading the Salesforce Voice package from 26.2.8 or earlier to 26.3 requires deleting the IndexedDB database nice-cxone-ccf once. Package dates are not the whole platform's dates.
objectives: Limit the reset to that upgrade
Separate package history from the platform

p: The IndexedDB page says that upgrading the Salesforce Voice package from 26.2.8 or earlier to 26.3 requires deleting the IndexedDB database named nice-cxone-ccf once.
This is a browser-storage step for that package upgrade. It is not a tenant wipe and it is not the AutoSummary mapping.

cites.title: Refresh Indexed DB After Upgrading to Package 26.3

p: Salesforce Agent release history dates, such as 25.3 on 11 June 2025, are package dates. They are not the platform release-cycle dates on the 26.2 or 26.3 notes.
Quote the page that matches the thing you upgraded.
